opening.argument: The presentation ties substantial projected returns to purchasing OneCoin packages, including a claim that money can double without further action: “If you take from 12500 and do nothing then also your money can be double.” It encourages viewers seeking good earnings to begin with a €25,000 package, while a displayed package table lists prices, token amounts, splits, earnings, and ROI percentages reaching 471%. It also projects very large income from a €5,000 token purchase if the token value rises, and directs viewers to a OneCoin signup destination. The visible pairing and matching-bonus structure further links package levels and percentages to sponsors on both sides, presenting recruitment-based bonuses alongside token appreciation and package returns.
